claims.assertion: Anéeka says an abandoned, damaged Lemurian-era ship remains in high Earth orbit after returning from space.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: She says the craft is over 12,000 years old and was placed in a safer orbit.

claims.assertion: Anéeka says investigating the ship is considered dangerous because accessways are damaged and an unknown organism may remain inside.
claims.speaker: Anéeka
claims.qualifiers: The possible organism is speculative; she also cites debris and darkness.

review_flags: The interview offers an unverified account of an ancient spacecraft and possible extraterrestrial life.
coverage_gaps: The discussion also covers orbital mechanics and the craft’s unknown origin and crew.
